proofDefinition: End-to-end autonomous dashboard certified: The Android APK contains a full autonomous dashboard UI that connects to 112 live IA engineering agents on production (https://api.ivxholding.com). The dashboard shows agent fleet status, code execution layer capabilities (file writing, build loop, AI error feedback, deploy), 30-agent app creation pipeline, and includes a live certification button that triggers a real AI agent to generate code, write it to disk, and run a build loop — all through remote AI inference (openai/gpt-4o at ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1). The APK was built successfully (15MB, BUILD SUCCESSFUL) and all 8 source files were pushed to GitHub.
